mika: Heads-up — the sample app in ./examples/node fails after we shipped the export-map change. esbuild picks the import entry, but the package ships only cjs at that path so runtime throws.

mika: Error (snippet): 
TypeError [ERR_REQUIRE_ESM]: Must use import to load ES Module: /workspace/pkg/dist/runtime.mjs

mika: repro steps:
1) git clone ... && cd examples/node
2) npm ci
3) npm run build && node dist/run.js

mika: package.json exports currently:
```json
{"exports": {"./runtime": "./dist/runtime.cjs.js"}, "main": "./dist/runtime.cjs.js"}
```

jordan: Can you paste the actual stack? Is it failing in Node or in the edge build for Vercel?

mika: Node 18 and vite dev both fail. stack top: 
TypeError [ERR_REQUIRE_ESM] at Module._compile (internal/modules/cjs/loader.js:...)

ash: Likely we shipped only the cjs path under a bare subpath. Quick fix is to provide conditional exports with import/require and types path, e.g.:
```json
"exports": {
  "./runtime": {
    "import": "./dist/runtime.mjs",
    "require": "./dist/runtime.cjs.js"
  }
},
"types": "dist/index.d.ts"
```

mika: adding "types" is key — TS/IDE resolution was falling back to the wrong entry and editors flagged missing types which confused users during onboarding.

tara: +1 on a patch. Also we should add a tiny CI regression that installs the package and checks both ESM and CJS entrypoints (node require + dynamic import) and a quick esbuild/vite spin to catch bundler resolution.

ci-bot: CI: examples/node -> test:integration:exports-map — failed 1 test (export-map-resolution.spec.js)

mika: I'll open a small PR to update exports + types and add the regression tests for esbuild/vite and node import/require matrix. tagging @jordan for review. Will add a blurb in the release notes and the onboarding docs.

jordan: thanks — also add a short note about edge runtimes preferring `import`/ESM; if we only ship CJS some serverless/edge builders will pick wrong entry and fail at deploy. Recommend publishing a canary patch and pinging #all-hands if onboarding docs need urgent updates.

mika: 👍 opening PR now, will include the test matrix and a one-liner changelog entry.
